findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "twitter" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_email_search_by_username, get_ShortUrl · Private data: get_AutoComplete, get_Search, get_v1_1_Trends, get_v1_1_Locations, get_v2_TweetDetail, get_v2_Tweet, get_v2_Favoriters, get_v2_Retweeters, get_v1_1_TranslateTweet, get_email_search_by_username, get_v1_1_Users, get_v2_UserByScreenName, get_v2_UserByRestId, get_v2_UsersByRestIds, get_v2_UserTweets, get_v2_UserTweetsAndReplies, get_v2_UserMedia, get_v2_Likes, get_v2_Followers, get_v1_1_Followers, get_v1_1_FollowersIds, get_v2_VerifiedFollowers, get_v2_Following, get_v1_1_Following, get_v1_1_FollowingIds, get_v2_Subscriptions, get_v2_UserAffiliates, get_v2_UserHighlights, get_v1_1_TranslateProfile, get_ShortUrl, get_v1_1_Hashflags, get_v2_ListTimeline · Public sink: get_v2_TweetDetail, get_v2_Tweet, get_v2_Favoriters, get_v2_Retweeters, get_v1_1_TranslateTweet, get_email_search_by_username.
